description: Search Canadian rental listings by city or nearby landmark and view matching apartments, homes, prices, photos, and locations in ChatGPT. Users can search by city, apply common filters such as rent, beds, baths, parking, pets, furnished status, lease terms, availability, and verified listings, or search near a landmark, university, building, or station. Results include concise listing summaries for ChatGPT and an interactive widget with listing cards, a map, pagination, and links back to Rentals.ca listing pages.
